hypotheses.H1_frozen_shared4_transfer: The original five-concept shared 4D basis stays within 0.05 median AUROC of each held-out concept's full quadratic form on every corpus with eligible concepts.
hypotheses.H2_frozen_shared32_transfer: The frozen shared 32D basis stays within 0.05 median AUROC of the full forms on every corpus.
hypotheses.H3_frozen_weight_coverage: The frozen shared 32D subspace captures at least 15% median Frobenius energy of eligible held-out forms.
hypotheses.H4_heldout_cross_terms: At frozen dimension 32, cross terms improve median held-out-concept AUROC over diagonal-only scores by at least 0.05 on at least two corpora.
hypotheses.H5_basis_universality: At dimension 4, the frozen original-concept basis stays within 0.05 median AUROC of a basis constructed directly from all held-out forms on every corpus.
